metadata.description: Profullstack plugins for Claude Code: c0mpute (hosting, chat on open models), ThreatCrush security, r4ck server search, Board as a Service, the boardroom advisors and CheapestWayz. Remote MCP servers, OAuth sign-in where an account is needed.

plugins.name: c0mpute
plugins.description: Publish websites on the c0mpute peer-to-peer network, chat with open models on it, make promo videos.

plugins.name: threatcrush
plugins.description: ThreatCrush security: scan findings and triage, incidents, IP/domain/hash reputation, fleet and webhooks.

plugins.name: r4ck
plugins.description: Search every VPS, cloud, bare metal, GPU and PaaS offer for sale by spec, price and place. No key needed.

plugins.name: board-saas
plugins.description: Hosted AI board meeting on a decision: five advisors give verdicts, debate, and a chair writes the minutes.

plugins.name: cheapestwayz
plugins.description: Find the cheapest way to get something done: priced DIY, online and local methods ranked by cost, local quotes, and referral links that earn.

plugins.name: boardroom
plugins.description: Five expert advisors and a chair run locally in Claude Code; /boardroom:meet runs the meeting.
